messages:
IncidentBot: Pager — high KV-cache miss/eviction rate on inference-prod, <https://pager.redwood.ai/p/INC-5241|INC-5241> triggered
Raj: Taking this — I'm primary for the shift. Quick status: errors up ~12% in the last 5m, tail latency spike on 4 regional workers.
Sam: On secondary. I'll watch dashboards and keep the customer-impact queue updated. Ping me if you want me to flip relay.
Taylor: I'm coming in for APAC overlap. Do we have coverage for the 02:00-06:00 PDT window? Concerned about cross-zone warmups.
Raj: Coverage is fine but we have a KV-cache thrash pattern. Suspect heavy prefix misses after rollout last night. First try: invalidate hot-prefix cache on the affected pool.
Maya: If you invalidate, we'll need to rebalance load briefly. Recommend canary invalidate on two nodes first.
Raj: Agreed. Steps I plan:
 1) run canary invalidate on pool inference-prod-ix-2
 2) watch qps and token-per-request metrics
 3) if stable, roll to remaining nodes with 30s gap
Sam: I'll monitor metrics and set alerts for >5% error increase during operation.
Taylor: Where's the runbook? Send link.
Raj: Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/kv-cache-thrash
Nicole: I'll update customers in the incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-5241
Raj: Canary command (on prod-admin box):
```
# invalidate hot-prefix cache for a node
redwood-cli cache invalidate --pool inference-prod --node inference-prod-ix-2 --prefix hot-prefix --reason "canary kv invalidation"
```
Maya: If that doesn't help, fallback is to route APAC traffic to smaller-seq models for short window. Use routing key `apac-fallback`.
Sam: Routing toggle command:
```
# switch apac route to fallback model
redwood-cli route update --region apac --route inference --target-model gpt-small-qa --policy temporary --reason "kv thrash fallback"
```
Taylor: Noted. Also, handback at 06:00 PDT — who's primary afterward?
Raj: I'm handing back to Taylor at 06:00 PDT. Taylor will be primary; Sam will remain secondary.
Taylor: Acknowledged. I'll post a short post-handoff checklist 15m before.
IncidentBot: Note: Pager policy escalation will notify SRE if error rate >15% for 10m.
Raj: Current plan timeline:
 - 2965440060: start canary invalidate
 - 2965440180: assess 10m metrics
 - 2965440300: expand invalidate if stable
 - 2965441200: prepare handoff notes
Sam: I'll keep the incident doc updated and annotate any user-facing changes. :white_check_mark:
Nicole: Customer comms draft queued — I'll send once we see stability for 20m.
Maya: If you need a quick rollback: revert the cache invalidation by triggering `cache-warm` job on the nodes:
```
redwood-cli cache warm --pool inference-prod --nodes inference-prod-ix-2,inference-prod-ix-3
```
Raj: Adding runbook shortcuts for oncall: https://internal.tools.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-quick
Taylor: Thanks. If anything spikes during handover ping @Sam and @Maya immediately. I'll be on-call screen.
Sam: will do. Good luck — keep notes simple for the handback thread.
Raj: Hands-on now, will post progress updates. :thumbsup:
